caseName: Boston Firefighters Union, Local 718 v. Boston Chapter, NAACP
caseNameFull: Boston Firefighters Union, Local 718 v. Boston Chapter, NAACP Boston Police Patrolmen's Assn., Inc. v. Castro and Beecher v. Boston Chapter, NAACP

opinions.text: C. A. 1st Cir. Motion of International Association of Fire Fighters, AFL-CIO, for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae in No. 82-185 granted. Certiorari granted, cases consolidated, and a total of one hour allotted for oral argument. Reported below: 679 F. 2d 965.
